Job Title: Java Developer
Experience: 2-5 years
Location: Fully remote within India.
Mandatory Skills:
- Java
- Spring Boot
Good to have:
- AWS
- Docker

Responsibilities:
- Join a fast-growing fintech product team building scalable backend services for payment processing and account management.
- Design, develop and maintain microservices using Java and Spring Boot, ensuring high performance, reliability and test coverage.
- Implement RESTful APIs, data models and integrations with internal and third-party systems.
- Collaborate with product managers, QA and DevOps to deliver features in a CI/CD environment and participate in code reviews.
- Troubleshoot production issues, perform root cause analysis and implement robust fixes and improvements.
- Contribute to architectural discussions, mentor junior engineers and help define coding standards and best practices.
